app.name: Budget
app.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
app.storageWarning: Your browser may clear this app's data when storage runs low. Install the app or allow persistent storage, and keep a backup.

passphrase.label: Passphrase
passphrase.hint: At least 12 characters. A few random words work well.

errors.COMMON: This passphrase is too common. Choose something less predictable.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Budget
onboarding.intro: Track income and expenses privately. Your data stays on this device and is encrypted with a passphrase only you know.
onboarding.passphraseIntro: Your passphrase encrypts all your data. You need it every time you unlock the app.
onboarding.lossWarning: If you forget your passphrase, your data cannot be recovered. Nobody can reset it for you — not even us.
onboarding.acknowledge: I understand that a lost passphrase means lost data.
onboarding.baseCurrencyHint: Used by default for new transactions.
onboarding.createFailed: The vault could not be created. Please try again.

unlock.title: Unlock Budget
unlock.intro: Enter your passphrase to decrypt your data.
unlock.failed: Unlock failed. Check your passphrase and try again.
unlock.wait: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
unlock.corrupt: Your stored data could not be read. Restore a backup to continue.
unlock.unsupported: This data was created by a newer version of the app. Please update the app.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.monthlySummary: Bar chart of income and expenses per month for the last 12 months. Total income {{income}}, total expenses {{expense}}.
dashboard.categorySummary: Bar chart of expenses by category: {{list}}.
dashboard.chartsCurrencyNote: Charts show amounts in {{currency}} only. Other currencies appear in the totals.

errors.AMOUNT_NEGATIVE: Enter a positive amount. Choose Expense for money going out.
errors.AMOUNT_ZERO: The amount must be greater than zero.
errors.AMOUNT_TOO_MANY_DECIMALS: This currency does not allow that many decimals.

filters.title: Filters
filters.searchHint: Searches stay on this device and are not saved in the address.

categories.title: Categories
categories.name: Name
categories.nameInvalid: Enter a name of 1 to 50 characters.
categories.inUse: "{{name}}" is used by {{count}} transaction(s). Move them to another category before deleting it.
categories.noReassignTarget: Create another category of the same type first.

importExport.title: Import / Export
importExport.exportIntro: Download all transactions as a CSV file that opens in any spreadsheet app. The file is not encrypted — store it safely.
importExport.importIntro: Columns: date, kind, amount, currency, category, note, id (comma or semicolon separated, UTF-8). Nothing is imported until you confirm.
importExport.skipDuplicates: Skip duplicates (same id, or same date, type, amount, currency and note)
importExport.commitFailed: The import failed. Nothing was imported.

fatal.NO_ROWS: The file has a header but no rows.
fatal.TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than 5 MB.
fatal.TOO_MANY_ROWS: The file has more than 50,000 rows.

rowErrors.INVALID_DATE: Use a date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
rowErrors.INVALID_CURRENCY: Use a 3-letter currency code such as EUR.
rowErrors.INVALID_CATEGORY: Enter a category name of 1 to 50 characters.
rowErrors.NOTE_TOO_LONG: The note is longer than 500 characters.
rowErrors.INVALID_ID: The id is not a valid UUID.
rowErrors.FIELD_TOO_LONG: The field is longer than 500 characters.
rowErrors.AMOUNT_INVALID: The amount is not a number.
rowErrors.AMOUNT_NEGATIVE: Amounts must be positive; use the kind column for expenses.
rowErrors.AMOUNT_ZERO: The amount must be greater than zero.
rowErrors.AMOUNT_TOO_MANY_DECIMALS: Too many decimals for this currency.

backup.title: Backup
backup.downloadIntro: Saves all your data in one encrypted file. Keep it somewhere safe; you need your passphrase to restore it.
backup.restoreIntro: Restore a .bgtb backup created by this app, on this or another device.
backup.backupPassphraseHint: The passphrase that was used when the backup was made. Your unlock passphrase does not change.

modes.mergeHint: keep current data; for items in both, the newer version wins.
modes.replaceHint: delete all current data and use only the backup.

backup.replaceWarning: All data on this device will be replaced by the backup. A copy of your current data is saved first.
backup.mergeInfo: The backup will be merged into your current data. A copy of your current data is saved first.
backup.replaced: Backup restored. Your data was replaced.
backup.downloadPreRestore: Download the copy of your previous data

errors.currentPassphrase: That is not your current passphrase.
errors.wrongPassphrase: Wrong passphrase, or the file is damaged.
errors.notABackup: This is not a valid backup file.
errors.newerVersion: This backup was made by a newer version of the app. Update the app to restore it.
errors.invalidContents: The backup contents are invalid. Nothing was restored.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autoLockHint: The app locks after this many minutes without activity.
settings.passphraseChangeFailed: The passphrase could not be changed. Check your current passphrase.

errors.CATEGORY_KIND_MISMATCH: The category must be of the same type (income or expense).
errors.CATEGORY_IN_USE: This category is used by transactions. Move them first.
errors.DUPLICATE_CATEGORY_NAME: A category with this name already exists.
